query: I accidentally made a transaction to the wrong account.
note: Bitext has this exact template with 'transfer'; the real word 'transaction' pulls BERT to dispute_ATM_withdrawal (conf 0.94).

query: I submitted a transaction to the incorrect account.
note: Same vocabulary shift, confidently wrong (0.98); just below the 0.99 filter threshold.

query: When I made a transfer, there was a fee.  Why?
note: Keyword anchoring on 'transfer' (make_transfer, 0.96); the request is about a fee.

query: I did not get as much cash as I requested at the ATM.
note: Clear ATM dispute; 'ATM' pulls BERT to recover_swallowed_card.

query: The wrong amount of cash came out of the ATM today when I went to withdraw. When I looked at the app, it was showing it was much more.
note: Same 'ATM' anchoring; long real query (25+ words), longer than any Bitext query.

query: I'm in Spain and my stuff has been stolen. My card was with it and I need a new one shipped and the old one frozen.
note: Multi-part real query; 'frozen' card = block_card, BERT says recover_swallowed_card at low confidence (0.48).

query: I do not know my passcode.
note: 'passcode' is rare in Bitext (which says 'password'); BERT guesses block_card at 0.40.

query: They charged me for paying with my card.
note: Fee complaint; BERT predicts cancel_card (0.80), not defensible under any mapping.

query: If I feel someone has my card information, can I get a new card?
note: Compromised card; recover_swallowed_card is not defensible.

query: I need to reset my passcode. How do I do it?
note: activate_card is not defensible; TF-IDF gets get_password right, LLM says set_up_password (the 0.92-similar sibling intent).

query: Is there a fee to exchange foreign money?
note: FX fees are not covered by Bitext; check_fees (general fee information) only partly fits, and 'foreign' suggests activate_card_international_usage.

query: Will I always be charged a fee for using my card?
note: check_card_annual_fee is an equally defensible Bitext reading of this question.

query: Someone else may be using my card.  There are transactions I don't recognize.
note: Mapped to block_card, but disputing the transactions is just as plausible (BERT and TF-IDF both say dispute).

query: Why am I being charged when I withdraw cash?
note: Disputing an ATM charge vs checking fees: both Bitext intents partly fit.

query: More fees, this time for withdrawing my own cash. Why are you robbing me?
note: Complaint about a charge; dispute_ATM_withdrawal is a reasonable reading.

query: Think someone has took money out with my card. What shall I do?
note: Labelled cash_withdrawal_not_recognised, but block_card is just as appropriate.

query: My ATM got stuck and I'm not sure what to do.
note: Ambiguous: the BANKING77 label assumes the card is stuck; BERT reads it as an ATM problem (find_ATM, 0.99).

query: Oh no!  I lost my card!  Help!
note: cancel_card is a defensible response to a lost card; Bitext separates block and cancel, BANKING77 does not.

query: WHAT CAN I DO AFTER THE CARD MISSING
note: Label noise: labelled activate_my_card but describes a missing card; BERT's block_card is the better answer.

query: Is there a way my new card can be renewed?
note: Label noise: renewing is not activating; Bitext has no renewal intent.
